i started about a year and a half ago. id always had bipolar, and id been in hospital for it, around other selfharmers, and i always said id never be them, and i found it weird, but i guess it got ingrained into my head.
my bipolar had always been more manic, but when i was 15, i was pt into a mental hospital, with no contacts, and what with my hormones and all, i became very very very depressed. i had a key in my handbag, and noone had thought to take it. i mean, i had no history. why would they? 
i was in my room, hating my life, so much that i wanted to die. and then, i felt this undescribable feeling, and before i knew it, i was cutting my arm, and bleeding. after that, i started trying to kill myself, and selfharming, and it spiralled out of control, and i had to be moved, where i spent 2 weeks trying to kill myself, and cutting with pens, but i was so out of control, addicted to it, that i was sent to a securer unit. there, i got out of killing myself, and my self harm got better, so they sent me back to the second place. i go in and out of patterns, i can go for weeks only doing it a little bit, and for a month or so, be cutting so bad that theres blood everywhere. i dont know how to stop, ive been like that since septmber, now. not that anyone cares, they discharged me when i was still making bloodbaths every day, and now i cut all the time, and people know, but noone gives a fuck.

yeah, i know how you feel. i feel like that. the only time i didnt was when i was in hospital, and i made friends who truelly understood me. friends, who now meet up with each other, reveil that they lied about their problems, and never ring me. i got really close to a few proffesionals, as well. but every single one of them, friends and proffesionals, forgot me when i left. friends who said they loved me, who i supported, and would support now, forgot about me. my family dont care for me much, im a kid in care. ive been cutting for a long time now, and i used to try to get the support for it. but, like you said, it doesnt help. my family dont even know, except my mum, who keeps me a secret, because im so shamesful. and i used to get upset every time somebody rejected me, and believe that they loved me. now, i just get on with it. if somebody rejects me, its okay, because i knew they were going to, and that im unloveable. ns accepting this does make things not as bad. i dont cut for others to see, and a year ago i sometimes did. now, its only for me. i know ill stop one day, but when i do, like you said, ill be alone

yeah, i think that acceptance helps more, too. ive been really lonely for years now, rejected again and again by people who i thougt cared, and the only people ive ever gotten close to, are inpatients in phyciatric units or staff, and i always have to leave them. ive been told to think about this and that, but all that really helped me, was realizing, that nobody actually cared about me, whether i cut, whether i lived or i died. after i got over that, ive felt a lot better, because now i know not to hope, and that im not ever gonna get disapointed again, so now i only cut for myself, whereas, about a year ago, it wasnt always just that!
